During the pursuit, officers recovered a .38 caliber pistol and a wet, muddy blue shirt believed to be connected to the suspects. During the arrest, Brandon ultimately complied and was taken into custody, while Carlos Cantu was apprehended by a police K-9 named Danger. He was treated for injuries following the K-9 apprehension, transported to Piedmont Henry Medical Center. and later taken to the Henry County Jail. The victims are expected to make a full recovery. Both suspects are innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.
